dog.description_text:
Do you have puppy fever? At 35 pounds and just 8-months-old, Willadeene is here with the perfect dose! Sweet Willadeene is described by her foster as "playful and joyous." She loves to strut her stuff close to her people and is learning the ropes of being a confident city walker. True to puppy fashion, Willadeene is full of curiosity, but equally enjoys curling up in a cozy spot. Little Willa will thrive with a forever family who is excited to continue to teach her how to be a confident pup!

Approved adopters interested in Willadeene can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not approved yet, apply today at hbrdogs.com.
